title: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
blurb: CloudSEK reports that the LiteLLM supply chain attack exposed over 434,000 CI/CD pipelines and impacted more than 2,500 organizations, including Nvidia, AWS, Samsung, and the London Stock Exchange Group. LiteLLM was never targeted directly; its CI pipeline automatically installed a compromised version of Trivy, which pushed two malicious LiteLLM builds to PyPI that ran on every Python invocation and harvested cloud keys, tokens, and AI provider secrets during a 40-minute window.

title: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
blurb: A supply chain attack on the LiteLLM Python library exposed an estimated 434,000 CI/CD pipelines and over 2,500 organizations, including Nvidia, AWS, and the London Stock Exchange Group, after two malicious versions reached PyPI. LiteLLM was compromised indirectly when its CI pipeline auto-installed a poisoned Trivy build, and although the tainted packages were live for only 40 minutes, the payload ran on every Python invocation and leaked cloud keys, SSH keys, and tokens.

title: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
blurb: The LiteLLM supply chain attack exposed over 434,000 CI/CD pipelines across 2,500-plus organizations, including Nvidia, AWS, Samsung, and Cisco, after malicious versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 reached PyPI via a compromised Trivy build token, per CloudSEK. The packages ran code on every Python invocation without an import and, though live only 40 minutes, leaked cloud keys, SSH keys, tokens, and AI provider secrets.
